items.title: File Adair County business personal property return
items.description: Missouri personal property assessment lists are due to the county assessor by March 1 (the next business day if it falls on a weekend).

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file the return; the personal property tax is billed on the assessed value at the local rate.

penalty.note: Penalty added to the tax bill by the assessed value of the unreported property, $15 to $105; it does not apply if the list is returned before May 1 (RSMo 137.280).
